title: Chicken Paella aux Fruits de Mer
description: A French-inspired twist on the classic Spanish dish, featuring succulent chicken, shrimp, and mussels in a flavorful saffron-infused paella.
instructions: Heat the light olive oil in a large paella pan or skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the spicy chorizo and cook, stirring occasionally, until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Add the chicken breast and cook, stirring occasionally, until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the mussels and shrimp and cook, stirring occasionally, until the seafood is opaque and the chicken is cooked through, about 5 minutes.
Add the saffron threads and their soaking liquid, chicken broth, and diced tomato.
Add the Spanish paella rice and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Remove from heat and let rest, covered, for 5 minutes.
